-- Save report summary
INSERT INTO company_metrics (company_name, metric_date, total_researchers, talent_score, calculated_at)
VALUES 
  ('OpenAI', CURRENT_DATE, 8, 92, NOW()),
  ('Anthropic', CURRENT_DATE, 6, 88, NOW()),
  ('Google DeepMind', CURRENT_DATE, 12, 85, NOW()),
  ('Meta AI', CURRENT_DATE, 10, 78, NOW()),
  ('Microsoft Research', CURRENT_DATE, 9, 76, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (company_name, metric_date) 
DO UPDATE SET
  total_researchers = EXCLUDED.total_researchers,
  talent_score = EXCLUDED.talent_score,
  calculated_at = NOW()
RETURNING company_name, talent_score;
